name: FUN_SENSORS_B
description: This table is to store the seed data of the sensor such as the sensor code and the sensor type, the implicit business conditions that are seeded which are the main entry point for the evaluation of the sensor business conditions, the default schedule of the sensor and the possible actions supported by a particular sensor.

columns.name: SENSOR_ID
columns.description: Primary identifier to identify a Sensor uniquely

columns.name: SENSOR_CODE
columns.description: Specifies the type of the Sensor category, like Payable Invoice Approval

columns.name: SENSOR_TYPE
columns.description: Defines the sensor type, like Approval

columns.name: DEFAULT_COUNT_THRESHOLD
columns.description: Minimum number of transactions that have to be present for the sensor evaluation to take place.

columns.name: DEFAULT_TIME_THRESHOLD
columns.description: Valid Value - Minutes. Minimum amount of time after the last execution of the sensor for the evaluation to take place.

columns.name: MAX_FETCH_SIZE
columns.description: Maximum Number of transactions to be picked for processing.

columns.name: MINIMUM_TIME_THRESHOLD
columns.description: Valid Value - Minutes. Minimum amount of time that can be changed by the customer for the time threshold after which the sensor has to be executed if count threshold is not met.

columns.name: SENSOR_PARAMETER
columns.description: Parameters that could be used in implicit conditions and supplied by end user. This are seeded parameters without any value or with default values

columns.name: SENSOR_ACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Actions supported for sensor of a particular category

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
